title: PM–Eng 1:1 scratchpad — inference (API/Console/Dedicated/Private)
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Arjun (Eng Lead) — focus: API/Console/Dedicated/Private
Date/time: 2025-08-02 10:00 PT (30m)
Attendees: Leah (PM), Arjun (Eng), optional: Priya (SRE) for Dedicated autoscale talk
Location: Zoom / #eng-hosted-api

Purpose / outcomes I want:
- Quick sync on Dedicated capacity rollout status and any remaining infra blockers.
- Decide prioritization between console features (route-level SLOs) vs. Dedicated autoscale stability work.
- Align on customer onboarding blockers for Private deployments (security checklist, helm chart churn).
- Confirm owners and due dates for follow-ups and customer comms.

Prep notes for me (Leah):
- Bring recent metrics snapshot (I’ll paste p50/p95 and cost numbers at top of meeting).
- One pager for Dedicated gating issues: autoscale flapping, node OOMs, template drift.
- Quick summary of enterprise prospect X (onboarding next week) — needs Private deployment checklist sign-off.
- Bring up console rollout timing: PM wants route-level SLOs by mid-Sep for beta customers.

Metrics snapshot (cut/paste into call if asked):
- Hosted API: p50 gen latency 45ms, p95 220ms (steady after batching changes)
- Dedicated pool (staging): p50 38ms, p95 310ms (spiky during bursts; autoscale reaction time ~90s)
- Cost signal: ~ $1.90 / 1M tokens on hosted using q4x quantized M-size baseline; Dedicated marginal cost ~30% lower at steady-state but higher on burst egress
- Errors: client-side 4xx stable; server 5xx ~0.02% last 7d, spike to 0.4% during 2025-07-22 incident (KV cache invalidation)

Agenda (15–20m core, leave 5–10m for action items):
1) Quick status (3m)
   - Arjun: blockers on Dedicated autoscale + SLOs on console?
2) Dedicated rollout health (7m)
   - Root cause of flapping nodes (OOM vs. driver mismatch)
   - Short-term mitigation (circuit-breaker + backoff) — is that ready?
   - Timeline for autoscale tuning and policy changes (can we guarantee <60s reaction for common burst?)
3) Console: route-level SLOs vs. observability polish (7m)
   - PM ask: route-level SLOs by mid-Sep for beta customers (need dev estimates)
   - Eng ask: is work feasible without impacting Dedicated stability? Options: A) Parallel small team to do SLO UI + backend Q (2 sprints) B) Pause SLO UI and allocate eng to autoscale (1 sprint)
4) Private deployments customer onboarding (5m)
   - Checklist gaps: helm values, KMS integration walkthrough, audit log formatting
   - Who signs off and when? Any urgent docs to ship?
5) Action items & owners (5m)

Talking points / prompts for Arjun:
- "What is the single highest risk item that could delay Dedicated GA?" (listen for infra vs. infra-tooling)
- "If you had to lock one chunk of engineering bandwidth this sprint, what would you pick?" (autoscale tuning vs. SLOs vs. private onboarding docs)
- "Are there quick wins (config, k8s tuning) we can push today to reduce p95 for Dedicated during bursts?"
- "For Private: which specific KMS/HSM patterns are still unvalidated?"

Context / background (notes to self):
- Recent incident (2025-07-22): KV cache invalidation caused repeated misses -> higher token cost and p95 spike. Root cause likely a corner case in cache eviction + CUDA mem pressure. Engineering patch rolled 2025-07-25 but tests incomplete.
- Sales/CS escalation: Prospect X (enterprise) expects Private deployment by 2025-08-15. They require KMS integration, audit logs, and a confirmed SLA. Need eng sign-off by 2025-08-08 to proceed.
- Product timeline: we committed to route-level SLOs for console beta mid-Sep. If autoscale stability needs full-sprint attention, we can shift SLOs to post-beta with clear customer messaging.

Options & tradeoffs (talk through):
- Option A (parallelize): Small team (2 engs) do SLO backend + UI; rest focus on autoscale. Pros: hits PM deadline. Cons: risk if autoscale needs more hands.
- Option B (consolidate): All hands to autoscale now, push SLOs by 6 weeks. Pros: reduces block risk to Dedicated GA. Cons: PM timeline slips; need to inform beta customers.

Possible decisions I want from Arjun in this 1:1:
- Do we allocate 2 engineers to SLO work next sprint or not?
- Can we commit to a short-term mitigation for autoscale that reduces reaction time to <60s by 2025-08-09?
- Who will be the sign-off owner for Private onboarding checklist? (need one named eng owner)

Draft talking script (concise):
- "Arjun — high-level ask: we need to decide whether to keep console SLO beta for mid-Sep or prioritize autoscale stabilization for Dedicated GA. Sales needs a sign-off for Private onboarding by 8/8. I want your recommendation and owners for follow-ups so we can brief execs by 8/10."

Follow-ups I want assigned during the call (put on board after):
- Action: short-term autoscale mitigation (circuit-breaker/backoff rollout) — Owner: Arjun — due 2025-08-09
- Action: Estimate for console route-level SLOs (backend + UI) — Owner: Eng lead for console (TBD) — due 2025-08-06
- Action: Private onboarding sign-off checklist completion (KMS, audit log examples) — Owner: Arjun / Security liaison Priya — due 2025-08-08
- Action: Customer comms draft for prospect X (timeline & caveats) — Owner: Leah — due 2025-08-05
- Action: Add autometrics card to console dashboard for Dedicated pools (p50/p95 + autoscale events) — Owner: Observability PO — due 2025-08-15

Parking lot (if time):
- Longer-term: autoscaler rewrite vs. incremental fixes (worth discussion in tech strategy).
- Consider adding a dedicated Dedicated-staging environment to run stress tests on infra changes (costly).

Notes-to-self after call (expected):
- Capture Arjun's recommendation and update product roadmap JIRA ticket (JIRA-2310).
- If Arjun asks for more data, prep 24h trace slices from 7/22 incident and mem profiles.
- Reassign owners in Linear and ping Priya for KMS sign-off.

Raw scratch area (copy/paste during call):
- Last week: autoscale flaps: 12 events, median downtime 45s, worst 7m
- Patch status: KV cache patch merged (PR 214) but still flakey in python shim; need additional e2e tests.
- Private checklist gaps: Helm values for nodeAffinity, CSI driver docs, KMS playbook, sample policy for audit log export

Tone notes: be decisive, offer staffing tradeoffs, emphasize customer risk but don’t micromanage eng implementation.

--- End of scratchpad ---
